**Job Description:**

  

**Job Description**

**About Us**

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
  
  
Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
  
  
We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
  
  
Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  
  
At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

  
  

**Global Business Services**

Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.

Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.

In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.

  
  

**Process Overview**
  
ARQ supports global businesses of the Bank with solutions requiring judgment application, sound business understanding and analytical perspective. The domain experience in the areas of Financial Research & Analysis, Quantitative Modeling, Risk Management and Prospecting Support provide solutions for revenue enhancement, risk mitigation and cost optimization. The division comprising of highly qualified associates operates from three locations i.e. Mumbai, GIFT City, Gurugram, Chennai and Hyderabad.

**Job Description**

As the Platform Product Manager, you will own the platform strategy, roadmap, prioritization, and delivery for GRM wide risk data aggregation and reporting solutions. You will work cross-functionally with risk, compliance, data governance, technology, and business leadership to ensure the platform meets both regulatory requirements and internal risk management needs. You will champion data quality, lineage, aggregation, controls, and automation while embedding sustainability, scalability, and auditability into platform capabilities.

**Responsibilities:**

* Define and maintain the platform vision, roadmap, and success criteria aligned to BCBS 239 principles.
* Translate regulatory expectations into actionable platform features and capabilities.
* Partner with Risk, Compliance, Technology, Data Governance, and Reporting teams to prioritize and deliver high-impact initiatives.
* Define and drive metadata management, lineage transparency, data quality monitoring, and report automation capabilities.
* Ensure the platform supports accuracy, completeness, adaptability, timeliness, and integrity of risk data.
* Collaborate with internal audit, compliance testing, and regulators on periodic reviews and assessments.
* Lead cross-functional agile squads prioritizing product backlogs, refining requirements, and overseeing product delivery.
* Develop KPI’s, platform health metrics, and risk data quality dashboards to monitor platform performance and compliance.
* Serve as the SME for BCBS 239 regulatory expectations related to data aggregation and risk reporting.

**Desired Skills:**

* 10 + years of experience in risk data management, regulatory risk reporting, or data platform product management within a bank or financial services environment.

* Deep understanding of BCBS 239 principles and their practical implementation in a large organization.

* Strong experience working with risk reporting systems, data warehouses, reporting tools, and governance frameworks.

* Familiarity with data quality frameworks, metadata management, data lineage tools, and control monitoring.

* Proven track record of defining and delivering product roadmaps for complex data management or reporting platforms.

* Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership skills.

* Proficiency in Agile delivery methodologies (e.g. Scrum, SAFe).

* Excellent communication skills (written, verbal and presentation) with the ability to translate regulatory language into actionable technical requirements.

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Computer Science, Risk Management, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

  

**Requirements :**

  
  

* Education : graduate
* Experience :Minimum 8+ years
  

  

**Job Location -Chennai /Hyderabad**

jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

You enjoy shaping the future of product innovation as a core leader, driving value for customers, guiding successful launches, and exceeding expectations. Join our dynamic team and make a meaningful impact by delivering high-quality products that resonate with clients.

As a Product Manager in Data Management , Data Catalog , you are an integral part of the team that innovates new product offerings and leads the end-to-end product life cycle. As a core leader, you are responsible for acting as the voice of the customer and developing profitable products that provide customer value. Utilizing your deep understanding of how to get a product off the ground, you guide the successful launch of products, gather crucial feedback, and ensure top-tier client experiences. With a strong commitment to scalability, resiliency, and stability, you collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality products that exceed customer expectations.

**Job responsibilities**

* Develops a product strategy and product vision that delivers value to customers
* Manages discovery efforts and market research to uncover customer solutions and integrate them into the product roadmap
* Owns, maintains, and develops a product backlog that enables development to support the overall strategic roadmap and value proposition
* Builds the framework and tracks the product's key success metrics such as cost, feature and functionality, risk posture, and reliability
* Defines the product strategy for agentic AI capabilities autonomous agents that automate data discovery, cataloging, quality remediation, and governance workflows
* Partners with AI/ML engineering to operationalize LLM and agent-based features, establishing guardrails for accuracy, explainability, human-in-the-loop oversight, and responsible AI use
* Defines success metrics for agentic features such as task automation rate, agent accuracy, escalation/intervention rate, and time-to-resolution

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* 5+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in product management or a relevant domain area
* Advanced knowledge of the product development life cycle, design, and data analytics
* Proven ability to lead product life cycle activities including discovery, ideation, strategic development, requirements definition, and value management
* Familiarity with generative AI and agentic AI concepts LLMs, RAG, prompt design, tool-calling/function-calling, and multi-agent orchestration
* Experience shipping AI-powered or agent-driven product features, including evaluation, guardrails, and responsible AI considerations
* Understanding of how agents consume metadata, lineage, and data catalogs to reason over enterprise data
* Experience with Data & System Thinking around Data Catalog/Data Management & Data Governance

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Demonstrated prior experience working in a highly matrixed, complex organization

jobs.description:
**Job Purpose**

The Enterprise Sales Manager will be responsible for driving revenue growth by identifying, acquiring and managing large corporate and enterprise clients. The role involves developing strategic business relationships, understanding client requirements, presenting solutions, negotiating commercial agreements and achieving assigned sales targets.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Enterprise Business Development

* Identify and develop new business opportunities across large corporates, MNCs and enterprise accounts.
* Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline through prospecting, networking and market intelligence.
* Generate leads and convert prospective clients into long-term business accounts.
* Develop and execute strategic sales plans to achieve revenue and profitability targets.

2. Client Relationship Management

* Build strong relationships with CXOs, senior management and key decision-makers.
* Understand client business requirements and propose suitable products and solutions.
* Manage key accounts and ensure high levels of customer satisfaction.
* Develop long-term partnerships to generate repeat business and referrals.

3. Sales Strategy & Revenue Growth

* Drive end-to-end enterprise sales, from lead generation to deal closure.
* Prepare sales proposals, presentations, quotations and commercial agreements.
* Lead pricing discussions, contract negotiations and deal closures.
* Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling.
* Monitor competitor activities, industry trends and market developments.

4. Sales Performance & Reporting

* Achieve monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.
* Maintain accurate sales forecasts, pipeline reports and customer databases.
* Track sales performance, conversion ratios and revenue growth.
* Provide regular business updates and sales performance reports to management.

5. Internal Coordination

* Work closely with Operations, Finance, Marketing, Product and Customer Support teams.
* Ensure smooth onboarding and implementation of enterprise accounts.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to resolve customer issues and deliver agreed service commitments.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* 5–10 years of experience in B2B / Enterprise / Corporate / Institutional Sales.
* Proven track record of acquiring and managing large corporate accounts.
* Strong experience in client acquisition, key account management and deal closures.
* Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Ability to engage with CXOs and senior business stakeholders.
* Strong commercial acumen and revenue-oriented mindset.

jobs.description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

**Scope Lead – Gloss Product**

**Role Purpose**

The Scope Lead is a senior, client-facing Product Lead for **Gloss**, a global post-trade platform serving international markets. The role owns the translation of client needs into clear, product-aligned scope and requirements, while ensuring delivery remains aligned with contractual commitments, budget, timelines, and the product roadmap.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Act as the primary functional contact for assigned clients and lead business-definition workshops.
* Define, document, and manage scope in line with contractual commitments, product capabilities, roadmap, budget, and delivery timelines.
* Help clients prepare Enhancement Request Forms (ERFs) with business context, requirements, impacts, assumptions, dependencies, and high-level solution approach.
* Ensure proposed solutions leverage standard product capabilities; identify configuration needs, product gaps, enhancements, and out-of-scope requests.
* Manage change control with Program and Project Managers, assessing and tracking impacts to scope, cost, risks, dependencies, and timelines.
* Prioritize Epics, Features, and functional and non-functional requirements;
* Participate in PI planning, backlog refinement, estimation, client demonstrations, and requirement validation.
* Partner with Product, Delivery, Conversion, Change Definition, and Program teams to resolve issues, manage dependencies, meet milestones, and escalate risks promptly.
* Build effective client and stakeholder relationships, manage competing priorities, and drive discussions and decisions to closure.

**Required Experience**

* 8+ years of experience in Capital Markets post-trade processing.
* 4+ years as a Business Analyst, Product Owner, Scope Lead, or in a similar client-facing product role.
* Strong understanding of the end-to-end securities trade lifecycle, particularly clearance, settlement, and post-trade processing.
* Deep knowledge of Equities and Fixed Income; exposure to FX, Money Markets, ETD, or OTC Derivatives is advantageous.
* Knowledge of key post-trade functions, including trade management, clearing and settlement, accounting, and regulatory reporting is essential.
* Proven ability to facilitate client workshops and translate complex requirements into clear, actionable ERFs, Epics, Features, and acceptance-ready requirements.
* Sound judgment in distinguishing standard capability, configuration, enhancement, and out-of-scope requests.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder-management, and written communication skills, with the ability to assess risks and escalate appropriately.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments, including PI planning, backlog refinement, and estimation.
* Experience using Jira and Confluence.

**Preferred**

* Experience with Gloss or any of the comparable back-office or post-trade platforms, such as Impact, BPS, Murex, Calypso, TCS BaNCS, FIS, Finastra, or Temenos.
* Exposure to European and APAC financial-market processing, settlement practices, or regulatory requirements.

jobs.description:
About IntouchCX
  
  
IntouchCX is a global leader in digital customer experience management, back office processing, trust & safety solutions, and AI services. For over 25 years, we’ve scaled with soul, building trusted long-term partnerships and empowering our people to drive positive change.
  
  
About the Job
  
We seek a dynamic and detail-oriented Partner Operations Analyst to enhance our operations. This role is vital for ensuring the highest performance standards across our Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) agents by gathering and analyzing key metrics, monitoring trends, and effectively communicating findings to enhance our operations and customer service. This role supports regional locations including the Philippines, India, and Latin America.
  
  
As Operations Analyst, You Will…
  

* Regularly collect and analyze daily performance metrics from BPO agents
* Identify trends and conduct comparative breakdowns of longitudinal data to provide actionable insights
* Monitor daily and weekly contractor staffing levels and provide forecast adjustments
* Prepare clear and persuasive presentations for internal and external stakeholders
* Share insights and overviews effectively, ensuring data is understandable and actionable.
* Provide prompt ad hoc communication with leadership when identifying trends or to push along coaching agendas
* Work closely with Partner Operations Managers to implement data-driven strategies and improvements
* Provide support and guidance to team members, fostering a collaborative and high-performing environment
* Understand and comply with company standards and policies
* Continuously monitor and evaluate agent performance against company standards and objectives, suggesting and implementing improvements when necessary
* Support new product and technology launches including UAT testing and communication release planning
* Be responsible for extracting production data from CRM, Dialer, and reporting platforms to formulate BPO production reports

As Operations Analyst, You Have…
  

* High school diploma or equivalent (required)
* A minimum of 5 years of experience in the contact center industry
* Preferably 2 years of experience in a Product/Operations environment
* Proven managerial experience with a strong focus on data analytics and operations
* Strong knowledge in Google Workspace (Google Sheets, Google Docs, and Google Slides)
* Excellent presentation skills with the ability to convey complex data to diverse audiences, including internal and external contacts
* Strong time management, organizational skills, and integrity
* A passionate commitment to quality and excellence in service delivery
* Strong focus on enhancing customer experience
* High resilience and ability to work under pressure with quick turnaround times
* Expertise in time management, capable of multitasking effectively in a detailed and organized manner

IntouchCX will never ask for payment, money, financial or banking information during the recruitment process. We only communicate through official channels.

**Job Description**

Associate Product Manager, Suite Experience

**Summary/objective**

isolved is modernizing the user experience across its HCM platform, built on a shared design system. In this role you will work from our Hyderabad office as the day-to-day product owner for three development teams, each building new pages and experiences for a different product area at the same time.

The design system is already in place, so the job is less about designing from scratch and more about building the right thing correctly. You will make sure each new page does everything the current one does, works for every user role, and handles real-world edge cases. You will also answer the many small product and UX questions that come up during development. You will work closely with US-based product leadership, and the role requires regular overlap with US business hours for handoffs, planning, and decisions.

**Core Job Duties**

* Document how current pages work, including fields, actions, user permissions, and edge cases, so nothing is lost when they are rebuilt
* Own backlog refinement and sprint readiness for three development teams working in parallel
* Write user stories and acceptance criteria that cover page behavior, validation, error and empty states, role-based access, and accessibility
* Answer day-to-day product and UX questions from developers, using the existing design system and escalating only where a new pattern is needed
* Review completed work against acceptance criteria and sign off before release
* Manage feature flags for your teams' work, within the release plan set by the Group Product Manager
* Take special care with compliance-sensitive workflows, where a missing date, notice, or record creates legal risk
* Keep roadmap items current in our planning tools (Airfocus, Azure DevOps)
* Work with US-based product leadership, support, and QA across time zones, through overlapping meetings and a daily written handoff

A seasoned, experienced professional with a full understanding of area of specialization. Emerging understanding of broader organizational context and goals. Resolves a wide range of issues in creative ways. This job is the fully qualified, career-oriented, journey-level position.

**Interaction**

Normally receives little instruction on day-to-day work, general instructions on new assignments.

* Attention to detail. You notice the missing field, the unhandled error, or the wrong permission.
* Comfort working from a design system and making sensible UX calls within it
* The ability to keep three teams moving at once and to prioritize under pressure

* Clear written English. Much of the collaboration with US teams happens in writing.
* Availability for regular overlap with US business hours

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Product Clarity: A clear, hypothesis-driven roadmap with measurable success criteria.

The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
Senior Product Manager, Data Platform
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead our consumer data platform. We have a modern cloud lakehouse in place and are now building the consumer data foundation on top of it: a canonical data model, a consumer data warehouse, and one trusted source of data for analytics, data science, risk and finance teams.
  
  
You’ll own the roadmap from the start. You’ll decide which use cases to deliver first, define how core consumer entities are modeled, and make sure each new use case builds on shared data instead of one-off pipelines. You’ll work closely with data engineering, data architecture, analytics and risk teams.
  
  
*This is not a dashboard-building role. You’ll own the data, definitions and metrics that dashboards, models and reports are built on.*
What you’ll do in your first 12 months
  
  

* Build a prioritized backlog of consumer data use cases with analytics, data science, risk and finance, and decide which 3–5 to deliver first.
* Define canonical consumer entities, such as customer, account, transaction, fee, merchant, country and currency, so they mean the same thing across products.
* Decide where products share a common model and where they need their own structures, and document the reasoning.
* Define single, governed definitions for core consumer KPIs such as active customers, revenue per user, lifetime value and churn.
* Write requirements engineers can build from: source-to-target mappings, grain, keys, history rules and data-quality checks.
* Track adoption: which teams have moved to the new models, how much they’re being used, and how many metric discrepancies have been resolved.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or an MBA, or equivalent practical experience.
* 6+ years of product management experience, including 2+ years in a data product or risk data role.
* Experience starting with many competing data requests, choosing the few to build first, defining an MVP, and explaining the trade-offs to stakeholders.
* Experience working with engineering to deliver a data lake/lakehouse, data warehouse or shared data model used by multiple teams.
* Experience bringing together inconsistent data from multiple source systems into common entities, keys and definitions.
* Hands-on SQL: you can join across tables, profile data for nulls and duplicates, reconcile counts between systems, and check whether data supports a use case without waiting for an analyst.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with consumer payments, digital wallets or fintech.
* Experience with payments risk data such as fraud, account takeover, KYC/AML or transaction monitoring signals.
* Experience with modern cloud data platforms and tools, such as Snowflake, Databricks, dbt or major cloud providers’ data services.

jobs.title: Product Manager – AI & Data Governance Platform
jobs.description:
Product Manager – AI & Data Governance Platform

Location: Hyderabad, hybrid · Experience: 5-8 years · Employment type: Full-time

About OvalEdge

OvalEdge is building the governance layer for enterprise AI. Our Data & AI governance platform helps organisations discover, understand and trust their data, so the AI built on it gives reliable answers. At its core is an Enterprise Context Graph that brings together cataloguing, business glossaries, lineage, data quality and policy management. On top of it we’re building AI products: askEdgi, an AI-powered analytics assistant, and a growing set of governance agents that automate governance activities..

About the role

We are looking for a hands-on Product Manager to own product areas across our platform, including AI capabilities, data quality and data lineage. You will work with engineering, design, fellow product owners and customer-facing teams to take features from discovery through delivery.

What you will do

• Own the product’s module/feature vision: researching market, competitors, customers and prospect discussions, RFPs and build a complete product vision and a multi-quarter roadmap for the product areas you own.

• Write clear PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria that engineers can build without guessing.

• Own the product backlog: lead grooming, sprint planning and the successful release of the features you own.

• Lead customer discovery and validate ideas through prototypes, proofs of concept, and beta programmes, while making and communicating clear trade-offs between new capabilities, platform investments, and technical debt to leadership.

• Define success metrics for each feature and use product data to guide the roadmap.

• Build AI features: design prompts, agent instructions and AI workflows, and work with the Enterprise Context Graph and search teams to shape how trusted context reaches AI features.

• Evaluate AI features: define quality criteria, build evaluation sets and test changes before release.

• Shape data quality capabilities: profiling, rules, monitoring, anomaly detection and remediation.

• Shape data lineage capabilities: end-to-end and column-level lineage, impact analysis and root-cause analysis.

• Partner with architects on model choice, data privacy boundaries and cost-to-serve.

• Work as a peer to the Software Architect: you own the problem and the outcome, they own the technical design and quality attributes. Resolve scope, sequencing and non-functional requirements together.

• Account for both SaaS and on-premises constraints, including upgrades, deployment, security and supportability.

• Support sales with demos and proofs of concept, and enable support and solutions teams on new releases.

• Partner with product marketing, sales engineering and support on positioning, launch plans, enablement, and pricing and packaging input.

• Be the product voice in key customer and analyst conversations on the product areas you own.

• Close the loop: review adoption, support tickets and churn signals, and feed them back into the roadmap.

• Mentor and coach product owners/managers on discovery, metrics and roadmapping, and help raise product management practices across the team.

What we are looking for

• 5-8 years of total experience in a product organisation, including 3+ years as a Product Manager or Product Owner on B2B enterprise software products, with hands-on backlog ownership in an Agile team.

• Proven experience in customer discovery and defining product metrics.

• Track record of translating ambiguous customer problems into prioritised, measurable roadmaps, with examples of outcomes you moved.

• Strong prompt engineering skills and hands-on experience evaluating AI features, including LLM evaluation and tracing tools.

• Working knowledge of RAG, agents, enterprise search and knowledge or context graphs.

• Working knowledge of modern data stacks: warehouses and lakehouses, ETL/ELT, BI tools, APIs and connectors. You can read an architecture diagram and challenge a design.

• Familiarity with data quality and data lineage concepts.

• Strong SQL, with a solid grounding in data models, data warehouses, metadata and data governance.

• Comfort influencing engineering, architecture, design and sales without direct authority.

• Strong written and verbal communication, including presenting to senior leadership and customers.

• Experience mentoring or coaching product owners or junior product managers.

Good to have

• Has shipped LLM-powered features to customers.

• Comfort with Figma, wireframing and rapid prototyping, including using AI coding tools and basic Python to build quick, non-production prototypes that test ideas with customers.

• Experience with products delivered both as SaaS and on-premises including upgrade, licensing and supportability trade-offs.

• Familiarity with connector or integration-heavy products spanning many source systems.

• Knowledge of privacy and AI regulation frameworks (GDPR, DPDP, HIPAA, SOC 2, EU AI Act) and how it shapes product requirements.

• Data engineering experience: ETL/ELT pipelines, tools such as Airflow or dbt, and platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery or Redshift.

• Expertise in data quality or data lineage, or experience at a data catalog, data governance, data quality or data lineage company.

• Experience with customers in regulated industries such as banking, insurance or healthcare.

90-days Success Metrics

Days 1 to 30

• Learn the product, architecture and customer base. Meet the Software Architects and engineering leads, and talk to at least two customers or prospects.

Days 31 to 60

• Own the current release backlog and write PRDs for the next two priority initiatives. Agree a working split of responsibilities with the architect

Days 61 to 90

• Present a 12-month data governance and AI roadmap to the leadership team, with metrics and trade-offs stated, and launch one customer-validated improvement.

In this role, you will serve as the bridge between commercial stakeholders and our advanced AI engineering team.

You must possess a deep understanding of business domains alongside a strong technical grounding in Artificial Intelligence, Large Language Models (LLMs), and autonomous agent workflows. Working closely with our AI Development Lead, you will translate high-level business requirements into granular user stories, actively participate in building Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), and ensure the engineering team is building AI solutions that deliver measurable business impact.

jobs.description:
* Full-time

**Company Description**
-----------------------

AbhiBus is a leading online bus-ticketing platform that aggregates ticket inventory from over 4,000 bus operators - including major State Road Transport Corporations (SRTCs), covering more than 3.5 lakh (350,000+) routes across India. The AbhiBus website and apps allow users to check amenities provided by bus operators, compare booking fares, check bus timings in the searched route, live tracking of the bus before arrival, cancellation protection options and other facilities. It is the official ticketing partner for several state road transport corporation bus tickets and IRCTC bus bookings.

AbhiBus is owned and operated by ixigo (Le Travenues Technology Limited), India’s leading OTA for the Next Billion Users. With over 54 crore Annual Active Users in FY25, ixigo offers AI-powered train, flight, bus, and hotel bookings through its platforms - ixigo, ConfirmTkt, and AbhiBus.

**Job Description**
-------------------

The TPM owns predictable, high-quality delivery across AbhiBus's technology programs. This is not a scrum-master role: you drive outcomes end to end, from planning through release to post-launch analysis.

You will be the connective tissue between engineering, QA, product and business stakeholders. You keep everyone aligned on scope, dates, risks and dependencies, so teams spend time building, not chasing status.

After every major release, you close the loop: measure impact, run retrospectives and post-analysis, and publish learnings across the organisation. As you grow, you will take on larger, multi-team programs.

Key responsibilities

**Delivery ownership**

* Own the delivery plan for assigned programs across 2–3 squads: scope, milestones, timelines, owners and dependencies.
* Break business and product goals into executable technical plans with engineering leads.
* Track progress daily, surface slippage early, and drive decisions to keep releases on date.
* Maintain a single, trusted source of truth for program status (roadmap, release calendar, risk register).
* Manage cross-team dependencies across backend, frontend, mobile, QA, DevOps, data and partner integrations.

**Scrum and agile execution**

* Run sprint ceremonies: planning, daily stand-ups, backlog grooming, reviews and retrospectives.
* Keep backlogs healthy and sprint-ready with Product, with clear acceptance criteria.
* Track sprint health metrics (velocity, commitment vs completion, carry-over, cycle time) and act on trends.
* Remove blockers quickly and escalate with clear options when needed.

**Stakeholder coordination**

* Act as the single point of coordination between Tech, QA, Product, Design, Business and Operations.
* Align stakeholders on priorities, trade-offs and scope changes; document decisions.
* Publish crisp weekly status updates and present program status in leadership reviews.
* Coordinate with external partners and vendors on integration timelines where needed.

**Release and quality management**

* Run the release process for your squads: release readiness, go/no-go, deployment coordination and rollback plans.
* Work with QA to ensure test plans, regression coverage and sign-off are in place before release.
* Coordinate hotfixes and production incidents with engineering; ensure follow-ups are tracked to closure.

**Post-analysis and publishing**

* Run post-release analysis for every major feature: delivery vs plan, quality, and business impact against agreed metrics.
* Run blameless postmortems with engineering leads for incidents and missed deliveries; drive action items to closure.
* Publish post-analysis reports and learnings across Tech, Product and Business.
* Turn recurring learnings into process improvements, templates and checklists.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 2–5 years in software delivery, with 1+ year as a TPM, scrum master, delivery manager or project manager in a product company.
* Strong technical grounding: can follow architecture discussions, APIs, microservices, mobile releases and CI/CD, and judge engineering estimates and risks.
* Track record of shipping features across multiple teams on time in a fast-moving consumer or marketplace business.
* Hands-on Scrum/Agile experience running ceremonies for at least one team.
* Working knowledge of Jira (or similar), Confluence and roadmap/reporting tools.
* Data-driven: comfortable defining success metrics and reading dashboards to analyse feature impact.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; can write clear status reports and post-analysis documents for leadership.
* Ownership mindset: drives to outcomes, not just tracks tasks.

**Good to have**

Engineering background (B.E./B.Tech or equivalent), ideally with prior hands-on development or QA experience. Experience in travel, ticketing, e-commerce or marketplace platforms with partner/supplier integrations. Familiarity with mobile app release cycles (Play Store / App Store) and staged rollouts. Exposure to observability and analytics tools (Grafana, CleverTap or similar). Comfort using AI tools to speed up planning, reporting and analysis. Certifications such as CSM, PSM, PMP or SAFe (a plus, not required).

**Additional Information**

jobs.title: Program Manager II
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you excited about building catalog operations for a new grocery store program from the ground up? Do you thrive when the problem isn't fully defined yet and you have to frame it before you can solve it? We are looking for a Program Manager to own catalog readiness for a new grocery retail initiative in Grocery Catalog Operations & Intel (GCOI). In this role, you will make sure every item the business plans for its stores has the product data that in-store systems need, such as point of sale, shelf labels, store ordering and planogramming, before those systems need it. You will turn open questions into decisions with owners and dates, put catalog milestones into the program's master schedule, and build the readiness checks and operating mechanisms that a catalog operations team runs store by store. Your ability to work through ambiguity, influence partners you don't manage, and raise risks early will be critical to your success and the success of the program.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Own catalog readiness end to end, including catalog milestones in the program's master workback schedule, a readiness check before each assortment and shelf-layout lock, and a go/no-go recommendation before each store opens.
* Frame ambiguous problems, name the decisions partner teams owe, and drive owners and dates across merchandising, category management, supply chain, store systems and catalog engineering.
* Define catalog data requirements with in-store system owners, including which attributes each system needs by product type and where each value comes from. Find where the program falls outside existing catalog processes and get those gaps fixed at the source rather than worked around by hand.
* Build the operating model with the catalog operations manager, including intake, SOPs, SLAs, escalation paths and a store-open runbook, and improve it as the program grows from one store to many.
* Define and publish catalog coverage and readiness metrics against the planned selection, using data to flag risks early, inform trade-offs and recommend where to invest.

  
A day in the life  
You might start your morning reviewing the weekly coverage report and notice that a category locks its shelf layouts in three weeks with a third of its items missing dimensions. You trace the cause to a data pipeline that only covers fully configured stores. By mid-morning, you are in the program schedule review with an owner and a date for the fix, and a fallback agreed with merchandising. After lunch, you work with the operations manager on the next store-open runbook, then draft a one-page note to leadership on an ownership question that needs a decision.  
  
About the team  
Grocery Catalog Operations & Intel (GCOI) runs catalog operations across Amazon's grocery businesses, including Whole Foods Market, Amazon Fresh, Grocery Partnerships and Quick Commerce. We create, match, validate and correct the product data that customers and stores depend on, and we build our own monitoring and automation so the team that finds a defect can fix it at the source. New store programs and marketplace launches across grocery rely on us for their catalog foundation. If you want to build something new and see your work on the shelf on opening day, we would love to hear from you.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of program or project management experience
* 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
* 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

If you feel like you are part of something bigger, it’s because you are. At Amgen, our shared mission—to serve patients—drives all that we do. It is key to our becoming one of the world’s leading biotechnology companies. We are global collaborators who achieve together—researching, manufacturing, and delivering ever-better products that reach millions of patients worldwide. It’s time for a career you can be proud of. Join us.
  
  
**About The Role**
Role description
  
  
Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. This role is the business product owner for technology, data and AI across Amgen’s Procure-to-Pay (P2P) process, from intake and requisition through purchase order (PO), receipt, invoice and payment. It translates the Global Procurement roadmap into a prioritized portfolio that improves automation, user experience and financial control.
  
  
Based in Hyderabad, this role connects intake and guided buying, SAP Ariba, SAP S/4HANA, supplier onboarding and contract management. It leads business priorities, requirements and acceptance with P2P process owners, Finance/AP, Technology and delivery partners across the US, Europe and JAPAC.
  
  
Finance/AP and Treasury retain payment authorization and execution; Technology leads architecture, engineering and technical operations. The P2P Technology Lead aligns partners on outcomes, commitments and escalations.
  
  
Roles and responsibilities
  
  
P2P technology strategy and roadmap
  
  

* Own the P2P product vision and technology roadmap within the Global Procurement technology and AI plan; prioritize investments against business value, risk, total cost of ownership and delivery dependencies.
* Lead delivery of P2P automation priorities such as touchless PO and invoice processing, AI-enabled AP recovery and overpayment detection, payment-term harmonization, card program enhancements and catalog expansion.
* ;">Lead delivery of P2P automation priorities such as touchless PO and invoice processing, AI-enabled AP recovery and overpayment detection, payment-term harmonization, card program enhancements and catalog expansion.;">Lead delivery of P2P automation priorities such as touchless PO and invoice processing, AI-enabled AP recovery and overpayment detection, payment-term harmonization, card program enhancements and catalog expansion.
* Evaluate next-generation SAP Ariba and embedded AI capabilities against business needs, release availability, integration readiness and adoption costs; recommend where to use native capability or a partner solution.
* Define touchless processing by process stage, with agreed eligibility, exclusions and controls. For invoices, distinguish processing without manual intervention from invoice receipt to ready-to-pay status from payment authorization and execution.

Platform integration and ERP readiness
  
  

* Lead business requirements for connected intake, procurement, supplier and contract workflows; ensure accurate transfer of approvals, purchasing data and transaction status across systems.
* Partner with the SAP S/4HANA program on open-PO transition, supplier master data, tax determination and e-invoicing; lead P2P business readiness for data reconciliation, end-to-end testing and cutover.
* Champion buying-channel compliance, including No PO–No Pay where applicable, guided routing, catalogs and approved exception handling in line with policy.

AI automation and data foundations
  
  

* Shape and scale P2P automation and AI use cases, including requisition validation, invoice capture and matching, receipt workflows and duplicate-payment detection; define baselines, acceptance criteria and pilot-to-scale decisions.
* Partner with Technology and control owners to define AI access limits, evaluation criteria, human review and audit trails; monitor errors and false positives, with escalation and fallback procedures.
* Manage technology vendors and pilot partners through scoping, value validation and scale decisions; review business performance, service commitments and ongoing costs with the relevant owners.
* Define P2P data requirements for the enterprise data platform; work with data owners on quality, common identifiers, lineage and access so requisition, PO, receipt, invoice and payment records can be reconciled and analyzed.

Portfolio governance and delivery
  
  

* Represent P2P in Source-to-Pay portfolio and program increment (PI) planning; maintain a prioritized backlog with clear business requirements, acceptance criteria, capacity, dependencies and committed or deferred scope.
* Balance run work (platform operations, upgrades, controls, mandatory changes) with transformation capacity, and govern each accordingly.
* ;">Balance run work (platform operations, upgrades, controls, mandatory changes) with transformation capacity, and govern each accordingly.;">Balance run work (platform operations, upgrades, controls, mandatory changes) with transformation capacity, and govern each accordingly.
* Agree KPI baselines, definitions, targets and owners with P2P and Finance/AP. Track touchless invoice rate, e-invoice adoption, first-pass match rate, cycle time, cost per invoice and on-time payment, alongside adoption and service performance.

If you are energized by turning complex business requirements into working solutions for life sciences customers, this could be a great fit.

We are looking for a Sr. App Services Functional Consultant to join our Life Sciences Application Services team. In this role, you will own requirements and testing for life sciences application implementations, from business analysis through release readiness. You will work closely with business stakeholders, development teams, and customers to help Model N deliver solutions that meet business objectives and quality standards.

jobs.description:
### **Summary**

Within DD&IT Experience & Adoption at Novartis, Data Analysts define how digital experience is measured and turn behavioral, survey, support, operational and adoption data into evidence that improves products, journeys and business decisions.
  
  
This is a hands-on senior individual-contributor role. You will combine strong analytical and statistical expertise with sound judgement, partnering with research, product, design, engineering and business stakeholders to make data trustworthy, accessible and actionable.

### **About the Role**

**Major Accountabilities**

  
  

* Own the measurement framework: Define experience metrics, baselines, benchmarks and appropriate usage for the products and journeys in scope.

* Analyze experience and behavior: Conduct segmentation, cohort, funnel, journey and driver analyses, applying appropriate statistical methods and clearly communicating assumptions and limitations. Quantify the size of issues surfaced by qualitative research, and pressure-test claims the data does not support.

* Design surveys and experiments: Develop reliable experience and satisfaction measures, and advise on A/B test design, statistical power, analysis and interpretation.

* Build the data foundation: Specify instrumentation and event tracking, and develop reliable data pipelines, models and dashboards with clear documentation and consistent metric definitions.

* Turn analysis into decisions: Translate findings into clear recommendations for senior product and business stakeholders, communicating confidence, limitations and expected impact.

* Strengthen user research practice: Partner with user researchers and accessibility specialists so quantitative and qualitative evidence are explored together, rather than stitched together afterwards. Set analytical standards, review work and mentor colleagues.

* Use data and AI responsibly: Protect associate data through appropriate privacy, minimization and access controls, and apply AI-assisted analysis with transparent human validation.
  

  

**Minimum Requirements**

  
  

* 8+ years of analytics experience, ideally in product, digital experience, customer experience or people analytics.

* Advanced SQL and working proficiency in Python or R for analysis and automation.

* Hands-on experience building dashboards and data models in Power BI, Tableau, Looker or a similar modern BI platform.

* Applied expertise in sampling, significance testing, regression, segmentation, driver analysis and experiment evaluation.

* Survey and measurement expertise, including established experience and usability scales and their limitations.

* Ability to define instrumentation, event tracking and documented metrics that enable reliable self-service reporting.

* A track record of translating complex analysis into decisions for technical, non-technical and senior stakeholder audiences.

* Working knowledge of data governance, privacy and responsible handling of workforce or other sensitive data.

* A bachelor’s degree in statistics, data science, economics, psychology, engineering, information systems or a related quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Parexel**
Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
  
  
We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose – moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart®.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Senior Business Analyst to join our team. As a Senior Business Analyst, you will drive strategic improvements across clinical research operations by analyzing complex business processes, gathering and translating stakeholder requirements, and designing solutions that enhance efficiency and compliance. This position plays a key role in process optimization, system implementation, requirements management, and operational transformation. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams across clinical operations, follow industry-standard methodologies, and contribute to strategic initiatives from planning through execution.
  
  
Responsibilities include leading comprehensive business analysis activities, conducting process improvement initiatives, designing solutions that meet business requirements, and mentoring team members. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Senior Business Analyst can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research operations and technology integration.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead comprehensive analysis of business needs, processes, and workflows across clinical research functions
* Conduct thorough requirements gathering sessions with stakeholders at all levels and translate complex business needs into clear, detailed, and actionable requirements documentation
* Develop use cases, user stories, and functional specifications that accurately reflect business requirements and validate requirements with stakeholders to ensure completeness and accuracy
* Analyze current state business processes to identify inefficiencies and gaps, document existing workflows using process mapping techniques, and design future state processes that optimize efficiency, quality, and compliance
* Develop recommendations for process standardization and automation, perform cost-benefit analyses for proposed process changes, and measure and report on the effectiveness of implemented improvements
* Collaborate with technical teams to design solutions that meet business requirements and develop functional specifications and design documents for system implementations
* Support the development and execution of test plans and test cases, validate that implemented solutions meet business requirements and quality standards, and develop training materials and support documentation for end users
* Lead business analysis activities for medium to large-scale projects, develop project scope and deliverables, create and manage business analysis work plans and timelines, and identify and manage risks related to requirements and solution implementation
* Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders across clinical operations, facilitate communication between business units and technology teams, and present analysis findings and recommendations to stakeholders at various levels
* Mentor junior business analysts and share best practices, stay current with industry trends and regulatory changes affecting clinical research, and identify opportunities for innovation in clinical processes and systems

**You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring**

* Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills with expertise in business process analysis, requirements management, and process improvement methodologies
* Proficiency with business analysis tools and software (JIRA, Confluence, Visio) and familiarity with process modeling notations (BPMN, UML, flowcharts)
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with advanced facilitation and presentation capabilities, including the ability to communicate complex concepts to diverse audiences
* Strong leadership capabilities including team mentoring, project coordination, decision-making, and the ability to influence without authority
* Experience working in clinical research, pharmaceutical industry, or regulated environments with deep understanding of clinical trial processes and workflows
* A patient-focused mindset, strong attention to detail, and commitment to regulatory compliance and quality standards

**Required Qualifications**

* 5 to 7 years of business analysis experience, with at least 3 years in clinical research or pharmaceutical industry
* Demonstrated experience leading requirements gathering and process improvement initiatives
* Strong understanding of clinical trial processes and workflows
* Experience with clinical systems implementation and configuration (EDC, CTMS, eTMF, etc.)
* Knowledge of regulatory requirements in clinical research (GCP, ICH, FDA, EMA)
* Experience with Agile and traditional software development methodologies
* Bachelor's degree in business administration, information systems, life sciences, or related field

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Professional certifications such as CBAP (Certified Business Analysis Professional), IIBA certifications, or PMI-PBA (Professional in Business Analysis)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
**About The Role**
At Roche Digital Technology (RDT), we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. As part of our strategic initiatives, we enable high-value AI solutions (with a strong focus on Generative AI and agentic systems) through fit-for-purpose platforms, services, and applications. The Applied AI Engineering Team is tasked with building innovative AI applications, GenAI agents, and agentic foundations.
  
  
In the 2026 tech landscape, the lines between traditional disciplines have blurred. We operate in small agile teams (typically ~9 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before (Agentic SDLC).
  
  
To support our rapid-turnaround, high-velocity engineering teams, we are seeking a highly skilled, deeply experienced IT Business Analyst. Operating in a highly regulated pharmaceutical and clinical environment (GxP), you will serve as the strategic interface between complex business priorities, regulatory compliance frameworks, and cutting-edge engineering realities. You are not a traditional analyst who merely documents requests; you are a passionate, technically literate individual contributor equipped with advanced AI skills (including prompt engineering & modern agentic workflows) and the business acumen to collaborate closely with product leaders. Furthermore, you possess strong Product Owner (PO) skills and are fully prepared to confidently act as a Proxy PO for the squad if necessary—managing the product backlog, defining sprint goals, and steering delivery timelines to align with Roche’s strategic objectives.
  
  
****Core Tech Stack & Scope****
This role requires a deep understanding of three core domains: AI systems, the life sciences and pharmaceutical business context, and the complexities of operating within a highly regulated environment.
  
  
The IT Business Analyst serves as the strategic bridge between complex business requirements and cutting-edge technical execution. You will take ownership of the end-to-end requirements lifecycle for AI initiatives, ensuring that all architectural designs and engineering deliverables are scalable, high-performing, and strictly compliant with global regulatory standards. By aligning technical roadmaps with strategic priorities, you will drive the delivery of robust AI solutions that provide measurable business value and maintain the highest levels of data integrity and quality assurance.

**AI Governance, Risk Management & Observability Specifications:**

* Ensure governance guardrails, escalation triggers, and observability requirements for agentic AI systems are applied
* Assess AI-specific risks (drift, leakage, tool misuse) and formulate TCO/ROI business cases

**Change Control, ITSM & Configuration Management:**

* Manage formal Change Requests (RFC) and present impact analyses to CAB/ECAB boards

**Audit Readiness & Operational Support:**

* Act as IT SME during audits, presenting validation evidence and requirements engineering practices

**Practical Skills Required**

jobs.description:
Overview:

**Are you ready for what’s next, now?**  
  
**About the Role**

The **Staff** **Product Manager – Data & Analytics** supports the definition and evolution of Aptean's semantic data models and Analytics Packages across business domains and products. The role translates business processes, metrics, reporting requirements, and underlying product data into reusable semantic definitions that can support analytics and AI use cases. Working closely with domain SMEs, customers, Product, Data Engineering, and Architecture, this role drives requirements from discovery through definition, technical validation, and customer validation. The role requires a strong combination of product thinking, business analysis, analytics, and hands-on understanding of relational data and data modeling.

We need a candidate who sits with an ERP SME or business user, understand the business process; inspect the underlying data/schema; define the business entities/KPIs; map source concepts to the semantic model; write requirements detailed enough for Engineering; validate the implementation (reports, AI query, or Agent outputs) with SMEs/customers.

**Knowledge:**

Requires strong working knowledge of data and analytics concepts, including relational data models, business entities and relationships, semantic modeling, analytical metrics/KPIs, and data transformation from operational systems into analytics-ready structures.

Requires the ability to understand business processes and reporting requirements and translate them into detailed data and semantic-model definitions. You must be comfortable analyzing source schemas, tables, fields, relationships, and existing reporting assets in partnership with Engineering and domain experts.

Requires working knowledge of product management and business analysis practices, including requirements definition, customer and SME discovery, prioritization, documentation, validation, and cross-functional product development.

Knowledge of enterprise software, ERP systems, modern cloud data platforms, BI tools, and AI-enabled analytics is preferred.

**Complexity:**

Works across multiple business domains, ERP/product schemas, and analytics use cases where business terminology, source data structures, and customer requirements may differ.

Translates sometimes ambiguous business questions and existing reporting requirements into standardized entities, measures, dimensions, relationships, KPIs, and semantic definitions that can be reused across products and customers.

Balances standard product requirements against ERP-specific and customer-specific requirements and identifies where extensions to the governed model are required.

Works through dependencies across Product, Engineering, Architecture, domain SMEs, Professional Services, customers, and other stakeholders to move semantic-model and Analytics Package work from discovery through validation.

This reflects the actual scope in the resourcing case: reusable semantic models are intended to span Finance, Sales, Procurement, Manufacturing, Inventory, Quality and other domains, with iteration occurring across ERPs and eventually non-Aptean systems.

**Supervision:**

Works with a high degree of independence within defined product priorities and objectives.

Receives strategic direction from the Director, Product Management – Analytics & Data Products and independently drives assigned semantic-model domains and Analytics Package workstreams.

Coordinates work across technical and business stakeholders but does not initially have direct people-management responsibility.

Escalates significant product, data, architecture, and prioritization decisions where broader alignment is required.

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Define business semantics and domain models.
* Lead discovery with product SMEs, customers, and internal stakeholders to understand business processes, entities, relationships, terminology, business questions, metrics, and KPIs. Translate these inputs into detailed, reusable semantic-model requirements and domain definitions.
* Analyze source data and define source-to-semantic mappings.
* Work with Product and Data Engineering teams to understand existing products and ERP schemas, including relevant tables, fields, keys, relationships, and business logic. Define and document how source data maps to standardized business entities, dimensions, measures, and relationships within the semantic model, and identify gaps requiring transformation or extension.
* Define Analytics Packages
* Translate business questions, KPIs, reporting requirements, and semantic-model capabilities into reusable Analytics Packages across functional domains such as Finance, Sales, Procurement, Manufacturing, Inventory, and Quality. Define package requirements, measures, dimensions, reporting experiences, acceptance criteria, and dependencies.
* Driving semantic-model requirements through Engineering
* Partner closely with Data Engineering and Architecture to convert product requirements into implementable semantic-model capabilities. Clarify requirements, resolve data and business-rule questions, review model implementations against intended business semantics, identify gaps, and support prioritization through delivery.
* Validate models and packages with customers and SMEs
* Plan and conduct validation sessions with domain SMEs, customers, and implementation teams to confirm that semantic definitions, KPIs, business rules, and Analytics Packages accurately represent real-world processes and reporting needs. Convert validation findings into prioritized product requirements and model improvements.
* Standardize capabilities across products and customers
* Compare requirements and source structures across ERP products and customer environments to distinguish reusable business concepts from product- or customer-specific requirements. Help establish canonical definitions while identifying where governed extensions are necessary…

jobs.description:
**About the role and team**  
  
Leading at Uber means setting direction in motion, not waiting for perfect conditions. As a Lead Product Manager (L5B), you will be the strategic anchor for high-impact teams responsible for critical aspects of our global marketplace—from ensuring user safety through cutting-edge media technology to building the financial and growth platforms that empower millions of earners and merchants. You will manage complex sets of stakeholders and lead a dedicated team of product managers to build customer-centric roadmaps that scale.  
  
This is a high-visibility leadership role in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. You will navigate the "messy" reality of global operations, making hard calls with incomplete information and carrying the weight of decisions that move the needle for the entire company. We are looking for an owner who is technically proficient, data-driven, and possesses the resilience to drive 0-to-1 innovation. If you lead with clarity, thrive in challenge, and are motivated to build the future of movement and commerce—this is where you’ll make your mark.  
  
**What you’ll do**  
  

* **Define Strategy and Vision:** Establish a bold long-term product vision and translate it into actionable quarterly roadmaps that align with global organizational goals and local regional needs.
* **Lead and Mentor:** Build and cultivate a high-performing team culture, providing mentorship to product managers while acting as the "collaborative glue" that inspires Engineering, Design, and Data Science teams.
* **Drive Execution:** Partner cross-functionally to deliver breakthrough solutions, obsessing over user experience and business impact while maintaining a high bar for engineering quality and speed.
* **Master Stakeholder Management:** Galvanize technical and business stakeholders at all levels, including executive leadership and external partners, to align with your vision and navigate competing priorities.
* **Deep Dive into Data:** Leverage quantitative and qualitative insights to make strategic trade-offs, solve complex analytical challenges, and identify and address risk trends.
* **Remove Roadblocks:** Proactively anticipate and eliminate obstacles that prevent the team from delivering on product objectives, ensuring a smooth path for high-velocity experimentation and delivery.

  
  
**Basic Qualifications**  
  

* 7 + years of overall professional experience with a proven track record of shipping bold product bets that alter business trajectories.
* Demonstrated ability to oversee comprehensive customer research plans and systematic processes for translating insights into innovative product directions.
* Proven track record of converting unstructured, ambiguous problems into clarifying, focused plans while managing multiple multi-team projects with minimal oversight.
* Strong technical depth: ability to identify technical challenges in advance, align multiple engineering teams, and serve as a trusted partner for Engineering Managers.
* Mastery of experimentation: experience partnering with Data Science to drive strong experimentation practices and prioritize roadmaps in a data-driven manner.
* Highly proficient in UX/UI paradigms: ability to advocate for best-in-class design quality and ensure teams design with a principle-first approach.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related technical/quantitative field.  

  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  

* Domain Expertise: Experience in Financial Services/Fintech, Online Marketplaces, or Video/Media-focused platforms.
* Strategic Influence: Product judgment that is frequently sought out by teams outside of your immediate product area.
* Operational Excellence: Experience documenting and sharing best practices to help other PMs achieve excellence in roadmap planning and high-quality delivery.
* High-Stakes Leadership: Ability to optimistically keep teams focused on #winning while overcoming significant adversities and limited resources.
Communication: Experience representing significant work in public forums and to executive leadership to generate alignment and support.  

  
  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.  
  
Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers - ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.

We are driven by a ‘user-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ & delivery - not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.

We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.
  
  
The Geo team is focused on building the most accurate, comprehensive, and useful maps for our users, through products like Maps, Earth, Street View, Google Maps Platform, and more. Every month, more than a billion people rely on Maps services to explore the world and navigate their daily lives.
  
  
The Geo team also enables developers to use the power of Google Maps platforms to enhance their apps and websites. As they plot a course for the future of mapping, they are solving complex computer science problems, designing beautiful and intuitive product experiences, and improving our understanding of the real world.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) by collaborating with partner teams (e.g., Engineers, Program Managers, UX) during product design and development to implement the requirements and turn PRDs into Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) for multiple teams.
* Own and define project roadmaps.
* Drive development and secure buy-in for a product goal that identifies, defines, and supports the overall product narrative and direction, achieving an outcome that is greater than the sum of its parts.
* Manage validation of market size and opportunity (e.g., user-based, strategic opportunity, business).
* Lead and harmonize processes to define, identify, collect, and track appropriate product or business metrics, both quantitative and qualitative for new or existing products or business ventures.

jobs.title: AI Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Jupiter**

Jupiter is a money app for people who are building their lives in India. From one app you can open a savings account with our partner bank, pay on UPI, save towards goals in Pots, borrow, buy insurance, invest, and see where your money actually goes. Our Edge+ CSB Bank RuPay credit card works on UPI and earns Jewels, our rewards currency, on the brands people already shop with.

We are a product company at heart. We obsess over small details, we read what customers tell us, and we would rather do fewer things properly than many things badly.

**Why this role exists**

AI is already part of how Jupiter works. Our product team uses an in-house assistant that reads our Confluence, Figma, Amplitude, Databricks and support tickets to answer questions and draft PRDs, right inside Slack. Engineering has a bot that turns a Jira ticket into a draft pull request. Marketing has a creative studio that designs ads, critiques its own work against a checklist and tells us what every run cost.

Those started as tools for us. The next step is bigger: putting AI in front of customers in a product that handles their money, where a confident wrong answer is not a small bug. We are looking for a PM who wants to own that problem, with the judgement to know where AI helps and the discipline to prove it before it ships.

**What you will do**

* **Find the problems worth solving with AI.**
  Explaining a declined payment, making sense of a card bill, help that actually closes the ticket, a Money tab that answers questions in plain words. You will also say no to the ideas where a better screen would do the job.
* **Own products end to end.**
  Problem, PRD, evals, launch, and the numbers after launch. You stay with it until it works for customers, not until it is merged.
* **Write the evals before the feature.**
  Define what good looks like with real examples, build the test sets with engineering, and decide the score that is good enough to ship. When the model changes, you know within a day whether things got better or worse.
* **Design for the moments AI gets it wrong.**
  What the assistant says when it does not know, when it hands over to a person, and how a customer corrects it. These moments decide whether people trust us.
* **Keep it safe and compliant.**
  Work with compliance, risk and our partner banks so everything we build respects RBI guidelines, the DPDP Act and our partners' policies. Customer data stays where it belongs.
* **Treat cost and speed as product decisions.**
  Know what each conversation costs, pick the right model for each job, and cut what does not earn its keep.
* **Raise the bar for the whole team.**
  Help other PMs, designers and analysts use AI well in their own work, and keep improving the internal tools they already rely on.

**Your first 90 days**

* **By day 30:**
  you use Jupiter every day, have read a few hundred support conversations, have sat with ops and compliance, and know our internal AI tools by using them.
* **By day 60:**
  you have picked one customer problem, made the case for it with real data, and put a working prototype in front of colleagues.
* **By day 90:**
  you have an eval set, a launch plan with guardrails, and a small rollout to real customers with one clear success metric.

**You will do well here if you**

* Have 4 to 8 years in product, with at least one AI or ML product shipped to real users. A demo does not count; something people used does.
* Can explain in plain words how language models fail (making things up, prompt injection, behaviour shifting between model versions) and how you would design around each.
* Are comfortable writing prompts, reading a model's outputs in bulk and spotting the pattern in what went wrong.
* Use data without being asked. You can write SQL, build a funnel in Amplitude, and tell a real change from noise.
* Write clearly. Your PRDs are short, specific and something an engineer can build from.
* Care about the person on the other side of the screen, especially when the subject is their money.

**Good to have**

* Experience in fintech, payments, lending or another regulated space.
* You have built with the Claude or OpenAI APIs yourself, even on a side project.
* Hands-on time with retrieval (RAG), agents that use tools, or eval tooling.
* You can sketch a flow in Figma before a designer picks it up.

**What you will work with**

* Claude and other frontier models through our AI gateway, and MCP to connect agents to our systems.
* Amplitude, Databricks, Jira, Confluence, Figma and Sense UI, our design system.
* A React Native app, and engineers, designers and analysts who like to move quickly and measure what they ship.

**How we work**

* Small teams own outcomes, not tickets.
* Decisions are written down with the reasoning, so anyone can pick up the thread later.
* We are honest about results. If a launch did not work, we say so and fix it.
