jobs.description:
About EdgeVerve

EdgeVerve Systems Limited (a wholly owned subsidiary of Infosys) builds AI-, automation-, and analytics-led digital platforms that help enterprises transform operations at scale, with security and scalability at the core

About AI Next

EdgeVerve AI Next is a unified platform designed to scale Applied AI across the enterprise, built from the ground up to leverage Generative AI and bridge silos across people, processes, data, and technology to drive transformation in business operations.

AI Next also includes platform capabilities that support flexible model choices and enterprise-ready foundations for secure, scalable deployments.

Role Summary

We are looking for a strategic and technically savvy Product Manager to lead AI‑First initiatives within our AI Next Platform team. This role focuses on creating scalable, high-impact AI solutions by partnering closely with data scientists, engineers, and stakeholders to productize cutting-edge machine learning models and AI capabilities.

As the champion of AI‑first thinking, you will help define and drive the roadmap for AI‑powered features, platform services, infrastructure, and tools that power intelligent applications across the organization and/or for external customers.

Key Responsibilities

* Market and Competitive Analysis: Conduct thorough market research to identify trends, customer needs, and competitive landscapes in the iPaaS space.
* Product Roadmap & Strategy: Develop product vision and roadmap based on market insights, customer feedback, and business goals. Own the product strategy and roadmap for AI‑first capabilities and features across the applied AI platform.
* Requirement Gathering & Prioritization: Collaborate with stakeholders, including customers, sales, and customer support teams, to understand their requirements and prioritize features.
* Product Development & Execution: Work closely with engineering, design, and other teams to ensure the successful development and delivery of product features.
* Translate AI research, prototypes, and experimentation into production-ready products by working closely with research, data science, MLOps, and engineering teams.
* Define requirements for AI services, APIs, platform components, and infrastructure needed to support enterprise-scale AI use cases.
* Collaborate with UX, engineering, and stakeholders to prioritize AI use cases that deliver measurable business value and outcomes.
* Establish clear KPIs/OKRs to measure impact and performance of AI-driven features; continuously optimize using data and insights.
* Evangelize an“AI‑First” mindset across product and business units—help teams adopt AI as a native capability in their products.
* Stay on top of AI/ML trends including foundation models, generative AI, and MLOps best practices, and convert learnings into actionable platform strategy.
* Drive experimentation and model validation pipelines, ensuring deployed models meet expectations on reliability, fairness, and explainability.
* Partner with Responsible AI / compliance stakeholders to ensure AI initiatives align with ethical, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
* Create strong product artifacts (PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria), communicate trade-offs, and ensure crisp alignment across cross-functional teams (UX/Eng/Data Science/GTB/Support).
* Support go-to-market readiness by enabling internal stakeholders with positioning, value narratives, and adoption plans (as applicable to the platform/module owned).

Required Skills

Product Management & Execution

* Hands-on experience in Product Management / Product Owner roles (B2B/enterprise product experience preferred).
* Strong ability to define problems, identify user/value drivers, write product requirements, and drive prioritization using data and business impact.
* Familiarity with Agile development practices (Scrum/Kanban), backlog management, and iterative delivery.

Technical & AI/Platform Understanding

* Working knowledge of AI/ML concepts (e.g., model lifecycle, evaluation metrics, inference vs. training, drift/monitoring).
* Exposure to APIs, platform products, and enterprise SaaS concepts (multi-tenant considerations, reliability, security, scalability).
* High comfort collaboration with engineering and data science teams; ability to translate between technical and business contexts.

Stakeholder & Communication

* Strong stakeholder management & ability to align diverse groups and drive decisions amid ambiguity.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, structured thinking, and storytelling for leadership and cross-functional teams.

Responsible AI & Governance Mindset

* Awareness of privacy, security, and Responsible AI considerations (bias, explainability, guardrails, human-in-the-loop patterns).

Industry Knowledge

* Industry knowledge across Supply Chain, FMCG, Retail, Sales and Distribution.

Education / Experience

* MBA from a good-tier institute.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering / Computer Science / related field
* 5+ years of relevant Product Management/Product Ownership experience.
* Experience in one of the following preferred - Business Process orchestration, Agentic AI solutions, Data orchestration, Transformation and Operational transformation

**Description**
Amazon is seeking a Senior Product Manager – Technical to drive the product strategy for Delivery Signals across IES marketplaces. They will drive what customers see on delivery related surfaces — badges, delivery messaging, trust markers, and the decision logic that determines which signals appear for which customers. This role sits at the intersection of customer experience and ML-driven personalization, shaping how millions of customers perceive Amazon's delivery proposition.
  
  
You will define the product vision and roadmap for evolving delivery signals from uniform display (same content to all customers) to personalized, context-aware delivery communication. You will work closely with ML, BIEs, SDEs, and cross-functional platform teams.
  
  
We are looking for a technically strong PM-T who can dive deep into system architecture, write detailed PRDs/BRDs, and deliver in complex, cross-team environments. Experience with customer facing CX designs is highly valued. The role offers senior leadership visibility and broad scope across 10 marketplaces.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Define the product vision and roadmap for delivery signals — badging, speed messaging, trust markers, and per-customer signal personalization across IES marketplaces.
* Drive the evolution from uniform signal display to personalized, context-aware delivery communication using ML-driven decisioning.
* Use experimentation and analytics to validate signal effectiveness and measure perception and conversion impact.
* Collaborate with platform teams and partner organizations to integrate signal logic into shared surfaces and systems.
* Communicate strategy and progress to senior leaders and align stakeholders across geographies.
* Write PRFAQs, BRDs, and technical specifications for new signal types and personalization capabilities.

**About The Team**
As Amazon’s DEX product team, we are at the forefront of the Customer Experience product thought leadership - working on some of the most difficult Customer Experience problems while partnering with research scientists, software developers, and business leaders. With the focus on driving real impact on Amazon's long-term profitability, we build new analysis from ground up, proposing new concepts and technology to meet business needs, and translating these concepts into robust scalable products that deliver tangible value to our customers and to the A.in business.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 8+ years of technical product management, program management or engineering experience

Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.
  
  
Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
**Our vision:**
A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.
  
  
**About the Role:**
Wrike is seeking a highly adaptable Senior Product Manager to join our global product organization. As a strategic leader, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of your product area, driving measurable business impact and solving complex problems for millions of users.
  
  
We are looking for a versatile generalist who is comfortable tackling diverse challenges as business needs evolve, but who is ready to immediately dive into a high-impact, transformative domain:
**AI-driven Work Intake**
.

jobs.description:
**About WorkIndia**

WorkIndia is India’s largest blue- and grey-collar hiring platform, built with a clear purpose: to provide meaningful livelihoods to 23.7 crore blue-collar individuals across India.

WorkIndia helps millions of job seekers connect with employers across the country. On the employer side, WorkIndia serves tens of thousands of businesses every month, enabling them to discover, evaluate, and hire relevant candidates at scale.

About the Product Organization

Our product teams focus on building long-term business outcomes across multiple employer journeys. Broadly, our employer-side charter spans:

* **Hunting:**
  Focuses on acquiring and converting new employers into paying customers through strong product-led growth and onboarding experiences.
* **Farming:**
  Focuses on helping existing employers succeed consistently by improving retention, expansion, and operational scalability through product systems.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**Product Manager with 3–5 years of experience**
to work on Employer Acquisition within the Hunting charter, owning end-to-end growth, conversion, and user experience.

You will define what to build, validate it through experimentation, and work with cross-functional stakeholders to ship impactful products.

This role requires strong execution ownership, first-principles thinking, user empathy, data fluency, and the ability to lead cross-functional teams to deliver measurable outcomes.

What You’ll Do

1. Ownership

* Own the product roadmap, driving growth, retention, UX, and funnel performance.
* Translate business goals into a clear roadmap and product priorities.
* Identify high-impact opportunities to improve conversion, activation, and user experience.
* Balance short-term execution with the long-term health of the product.

2. User Thinking & Product Judgment

* Develop a deep understanding of user needs, behaviours, and pain points.
* Ensure product decisions are grounded in real user outcomes.
* Translate user insights into scalable product improvements.
* Advocate for user impact while balancing business constraints.

3. Business & Product Leadership

* Own business outcomes for the product, not just individual features.
* Connect product decisions to measurable business impact.
* Partner with business teams to ensure product strategy reflects business goals.
* Influence cross-functional priorities and drive alignment with partner teams.

4. Execution & Systems Thinking

* Write clear PRDs with well-defined goals, scope, and success criteria.
* Design and run A/B experiments to validate major bets, including sizing, rollout percentage, and result analysis.
* Drive high-quality execution by working closely with Engineering and Design teams through to launch.
* Identify recurring product problems and propose scalable solutions rather than one-off fixes.
* Anticipate risks and proactively adjust plans.

5. Data & Decision-Making

* Use data to drive prioritisation and product problem discovery.
* Leverage analytics and experimentation to validate hypotheses.
* Own product metrics and outcomes end-to-end.
* Distinguish meaningful business outcomes from vanity metrics.

6. Cross-Functional Leadership

* Collaborate closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Customer Experience (CX), Sales, and Marketing to ship and scale products.
* Create clarity in ambiguous situations and resolve trade-offs constructively.
* Lead through influence with peers and cross-functional partners.

What We’re Looking For

* 3–5 years of Product Management experience.
* Experience in marketplace or consumer internet products is preferred.
* Proven experience designing and running end-to-end A/B experiments, including sizing, rollout percentage, and result analysis, in close collaboration with Design.
* A track record of shipping user-facing features that have delivered measurable results.
* Strong data fluency and the ability to use data for prioritisation and storytelling.
* Comfort operating in ambiguous environments.

Team & Reporting

* **Reports to:**
  Group Product Manager
* **Key Stakeholders:**
  Business, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Analytics, and Sales.

Why Join WorkIndia?

* **Impact:**
  Be part of a mission-driven company that impacts millions of lives every day.
* **Growth:**
  Work in a high-ownership environment where your initiatives directly shape the company’s growth and culture.
* **Location:**
  HSR Layout, Bangalore.

jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level.
  
  
As a Software Engineer III at JPMorgan Chase within the Infrastructure Platforms team, you serve as a seasoned member of an agile delivery team to validate and assure market-leading ServiceNow solutions in a secure, stable, and scalable way. You are responsible for executing and improving testing practices across ServiceNow applications and workflows, ensuring releases meet functional, integration, performance, and control requirements in support of the firm's business objectives.  
  
**Job responsibilities**

* Execute QA activities including test planning, test case creation, test execution, defect triage, and test reporting for ServiceNow releases (e.g., ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HRSD, CSM, SecOps as applicable).
* Design and maintain the scalable manual and automated regression and performance test suites for ServiceNow configurations and customizations (workflows/Flow Designer, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, integrations, portals).
* Perform functional, regression, smoke, integration, and end-to-end testing across ServiceNow and upstream/downstream systems (APIs, MID Server, SSO, CMDB-related integrations).
* Partner with developers, product owners, and platform teams to review requirements and acceptance criteria, identify test scenarios, and ensure appropriate coverage and traceability.
* Log, track, and manage defects with clear reproduction steps, severity/priority, and evidence; validate fixes and support release readiness decisions.
* Produce and maintain test artifacts (test plans, test cases, test data approach, RTM as needed) and contribute to release documentation and operational readiness.
* Analyze testing results and trends to identify recurring defects, root causes, and quality risks, recommending improvements to process, controls, and platform hygiene.
* Support CI/CD quality gates by integrating testing into pipelines where applicable and promoting consistent QA standards across environments (DEV/TEST/UAT/PROD).
* Leverages enterprise-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness.
* Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3+ years applied experience
* Hands-on practical experience in QA/testing within the Software Development Life Cycle, including test design, execution, defect management, and release validation.
* Experience testing ServiceNow configurations/customizations and understanding of core platform components (tables, forms, lists, ACLs, notifications, workflows/Flow Designer).
* Working knowledge of Agile delivery practices and QA in iterative release cycles; familiarity with CI/CD concepts and environment promotion practices.
* Experience with test management and defect tracking tools (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow Agile Development, or similar).
* Basic understanding of web technologies and APIs (HTTP, REST, JSON) and ability to validate integrations using logs and test tools (e.g., Postman or equivalent).
* Ability to create clear, actionable documentation and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Understanding of security and controls concepts relevant to testing (e.g., access controls/roles, data handling, auditability, evidence capture).
* Hands-on experience using enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
* Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Experience with ServiceNow test automation (e.g., ATF – Automated Test Framework) and/or automation frameworks/tools used alongside ServiceNow.
* Familiarity with CMDB and ITIL-aligned processes (Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Asset/Discovery).
* Exposure to performance testing concepts and non-functional testing (availability, resiliency, audit/compliance readiness).
* Experience validating SSO, LDAP, and multi-system integrations involving MID Server, integration hubs, or enterprise APIs.

**Job Title - Technical Product Owner**

**Location - Bangalore (Whitefield)**

**Experience - 3 to 5 years**

**Allocated Budget: 10 – 12 LPA (Non Negotiable)**

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a Technical Product Owner to own what the company build and how it ships.
**You will own the product and feature roadmap, keep quality high by reviewing pull requests for standards and compliance, run the testing cycle, and shepherd every feature to a clean go-live**
.

This is a delivery and ownership role, not a hands-on coding role — you won’t be writing features day to day. But you must be technical enough to read code, judge whether a change meets our standards, and hold a confident conversation with developers and QA. You are the person who makes sure the right things ship, and that they ship well.

**What You’ll Do:**

•Own and maintain the product and feature roadmap; turn business needs into clear specs and user stories.

•Prioritise features and manage the backlog with stakeholders.

•Review pull requests for standards and compliance — tests present, conventions followed, tickets linked — and route issues back to developers.

•Plan and manage the test cycle — test plans, regression, and UAT.

•Coordinate and own go-lives and releases, including checklists and rollback readiness.

•Work closely with developers, QA, and business stakeholders to keep delivery on track.

**What We’re Looking For:**

•
**4–5 years in a product, delivery, with enough technical background to read code and judge whether a change meets standards.**

•Experience owning a product or feature roadmap: requirements, prioritisation, and specs.

•Experience reviewing work for quality and compliance (PRs, test coverage, standards).

•Experience planning and managing a testing / QA cycle.

•Experience managing releases and go-lives, including rollback planning.

•Strong communication and coordination across developers, QA, and business.

**This Role Is Not a Fit If…**

•You are a pure project manager with no ability to read code or judge technical quality.

•You have never owned a roadmap, a test cycle, or a release.

•You need someone else to make every call on scope, quality, and go / no-go.

**Nice to Have:**

•Familiarity with our stack (Angular, Python, AWS).

•Agile / Scrum experience.

•Fluency with tools like Jira and GitHub pull requests.

•A past hands-on engineering or QA background you can point to.

* **Analytics & Reporting:** Develop and maintain dashboards and reports that track size curve accuracy, grid productivity, and inventory performance. Produce analysis that drives meaningful business discussions and supports both pre-season planning and in-season decision-making.
* **Data Infrastructure & Governance:** Build and maintain data pipelines to support regular and ad-hoc analytical needs. Partner with the data governance team to identify data quality gaps and provide clear, actionable recommendations to ensure sizing data products meet business requirements.
* **Size Grid Strategy:** Leverage data and statistical framework to measure and track productivity of size offerings. Partner cross-functionally with Merchandising, Sales, Allocation, and Planning to deliver effective size grid productivity tracking dashboards that maximize inventory investment returns.
* **AI/ML Support:** Validate machine learning profile accuracy and provide structured feedback to data scientists to improve model performance. Participate in user acceptance testing for digital sizing tools and contribute to the broader AI/ML development roadmap.
* **Stakeholder Communication & Coordination:** Craft clear, data-driven narratives for a range of stakeholders — from operational teams to senior leadership — to inform both short and long term business decisions. Align sizing deliverables with GTM milestones and communicate proactively across functions.
* **Sizing Tool Expertise:** Serve as a subject-matter expert on sizing tools and systems. Train users and provide ongoing support to ensure consistent adoption and effective use across teams.

**About You**

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Data Science, Statistics, or a related analytical field.
* Experience: Minimum 4 years experience in data analytics, merchandising, demand planning, inventory management, or a comparable analytical role. Prior exposure to ML or data science workflows is a plus.

jobs.description:
3M has a long-standing reputation as a company committed to innovation. We provide the freedom to explore and encourage curiosity and creativity. We gain new insight from diverse thinking, and take risks on new ideas. Here, you can apply your talent in bold ways that matter.

**Job Description:**

**Data Analyst and Auditor Support – Environment Health and Safety**

**Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World**

Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company you choose will support and guide you. With a wide variety of people, global locations, technologies, and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers.

**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role:**

The Data Analyst and Auditor Support –Environment Health and Safety is responsible for supporting the health and safety audit function for 3M (Global Audits), with a focus on corrective action oversight and audit data analysis. This role serves as the review and approval point for audit finding closures and extensions, ensuring corrective actions are effective, sustainable, and aligned with regulatory requirements and internal expectations. Through trending and analysis of findings across sites and audit cycles, the position helps identify systemic risks, informs audit program priorities, and contributes to a culture of openness, transparency, and continuous improvement.

As the **Data Analyst and Auditor Support – Environment Health and Safety,** you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:

* Reviewing corrective actions and supporting evidence to approve or reject audit finding closures, aligning with site partners, and verifying that the recommended resolution and applicable local regulatory requirements are met.
* Evaluating finding extension requests against defined criteria (justification, interim controls, and revised timeline), aligning with site partners and approving, rejecting, or escalating as appropriate.
* Monitoring open, overdue, and repeatedly extended findings and partnering with sites and business partners to drive timely, sustainable closure.
* Documenting closure and extension decisions consistently to maintain a clear and defensible audit trail.
* Using environment health and safety subject-matter expertise to assess the adequacy of corrective actions across areas such as machine safeguarding, hazardous energy control (lockout/tagout), fire and life safety, industrial hygiene, ergonomics, process safety, contractor safety, and related regulatory programs.
* Maintaining the accuracy and completeness of audit finding data within the audit management system.
* Analyzing finding and audit data to identify trends, repeat findings, systemic issues, and higher-risk sites, regulatory topics, or business groups.
* Developing and maintaining dashboards, metrics, and periodic reports (e.g., closure rates, finding aging, extension frequency, repeat findings) for the audit program manager, business partners, and senior leadership.
* Benchmarking corrective action solutions across sites to share effective practices and enable efficient finding closure.
* Collaborating with the audit program manager, auditors, and health and safety SMEs to maintain and enhance audit protocols based on data insights, regulatory changes, industry practices, and internal needs.
* Lead the preparation and timely distribution of audit reports, and the scheduling and coordination of audit activities with site and business partners.
* Escalating critical compliance risks, systemic issues, or barriers to closure according to audit program processes.
* Maintaining up-to-date knowledge of Environment health and safety regulatory requirements and related changes.

**Your Skills and Expertise:**

To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3M requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in occupational Environment Health and Safety, Industrial Hygiene, Safety Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 5 years of health and safety compliance, auditing, or program management experience in manufacturing, industrial, or chemical industry environments.
* Strong knowledge of regional environment, health and safety regulatory programs and/or the ability to learn and understand individual regulatory obligations.
* Demonstrated ability to objectively evaluate corrective actions and evidence and make well-supported closure and extension decisions.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel (including pivot tables, formulas, and charts), Word, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint.
* Demonstrated ability to manage time effectively, prioritize a high volume of reviews, and meet deadlines.

**Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:**

* 7+ years of health and safety experience.
* Prior auditing experience (internal, external, or third-party) and/or professional credentials (e.g., ISO 45001 Lead Auditor, CSP, CIH, NEBOSH).
* Experience with data visualization or analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) and audit or EHS management systems.
* Experience with root cause analysis and corrective and preventive action (CAPA) methodologies.
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional or global teams.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including presenting data insights to leadership.
* **Work Location: Hebbal, Bangalore (Karnataka), Hybrid Mode**

**Supporting Your Well-being**

3M offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, 3M regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

  
Learn more about 3M’s creative solutions to the world’s problems at www.3M.com or on Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn @3M.S…

**Job Description**

Role Summary:

The AI Platform Product team is building a scalable, enterprise‑grade platforms that enables teams across the organization to develop, deploy, operate, and govern AI/ML solutions at global scale. The team focuses on providing reliable, secure, and reusable platform capabilities that support the full AI/ML lifecycle - from data and feature enablement to model training, deployment, monitoring, and optimization.

The team partners closely with engineering, data science, product, and business teams to ensure AI capabilities can be delivered efficiently and responsibly across multiple use cases, including fraud, risk, authorization, and ecosystem protection.

We are seeking a hands‑on Product Analyst with experience across AI/ML platforms, data‑driven product development, and GenAI prototyping. This role is ideal for someone who is technically grounded, product‑oriented, and adaptable, and can work across multiple problem spaces as priorities evolve.

Key Responsibilities:

* Drive and support product requirements for AI/ML and Generative AI platform capabilities, partnering closely with engineering, data science, and MLOps teams.
* Translate business, data science, and platform needs into well-defined features, user stories, technical requirements, workflows, and acceptance criteria.
* Contribute to platform capabilities across AI/ML lifecycle management, Generative AI enablement, feature engineering and feature platforms, developer tooling, and observability.
* Develop a strong understanding of end-to-end AI/ML workflows, including data preparation, feature engineering, model development, inference, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
* Apply hands-on technical skills using Python, SQL, APIs, notebooks, and AI/ML tools to analyze data, validate solutions, troubleshoot issues, and develop prototypes.
* Support Generative AI capabilities involving Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG, embeddings, evaluation, and agentic AI patterns, working with engineering teams to translate prototypes and use cases into scalable platform capabilities.
* Work with technologies such as Databricks and cloud environments to understand AI/ML workloads and incorporate relevant technical considerations into product requirements and solution trade-offs.
* Develop an understanding of feature engineering and feature platforms, including how features are computed, transformed, stored, discovered, reused, and consumed by AI/ML applications.
* Understand large-scale data processing across cloud and on-premises environments, including batch and real-time/streaming workloads, as they relate to AI/ML platform capabilities.
* Conduct product and technical acceptance validation prior to release and support successful adoption of AI/ML platform capabilities by user and stakeholder teams.
* Collaborate effectively with Product, Engineering, Data Science, MLOps, Infrastructure, Security, and Governance teams within an Agile environment to accelerate delivery and time-to-market.
* Own assigned platform initiatives from requirements definition through delivery, release, and post-launch validation.
* Create and maintain product and technical documentation, including requirements, workflows, release notes, technical guidance, FAQs, and runbooks, to support stakeholders and platform adoption.
* Remain flexible and adaptable, supporting multiple product initiatives and evolving AI/ML platform priorities.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* 2+ years of relevant work experience with a bachelor's degree, or 1+ years of relevant work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g., Master's, MBA).

Preferred Qualifications:

* 2+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Analysis, Technical Product Management, Business Analysis, AI/ML platforms, software development, data science/engineering, or a related technical role.
* Good understanding of AI/ML concepts and the model lifecycle, including data preparation, feature engineering, model development, inference, deployment, and monitoring.
